items.title: OpenDots
items.description: Your always-on AI coworkers that move between text, calls, and Slack.
items.summary: OpenDots is an open-source template for persistent AI agents that move between text, calls, and Slack, each with its own computer. Available on Web and Mobile, it is built with CopilotKit and AG-UI and is fully self-hostable. The GitHub repository describes it as "always-on AI coworkers" and mentions it is MIT Alpha licensed. Instagram posts describe it as a self-hosted template for always-on AI coworkers, each getting its own computer, files, and browser, with features like real-time agent status, event inspection, and integration with React and Next.js via CopilotKit.

items.title: dots
items.description: Open-source dots for the web: an AI agent with its own browser, one that does not get blocked.
items.summary: According to the sources, dots is an open-source AI agent with its own browser that does not get blocked. It is developed by feder-cr and has its own Firefox engine patched in C++ to avoid detection. The project is MIT licensed and has 2,000 stars on GitHub. It is not affiliated with OpenAI and provides a real Firefox engine with a unique identity per seed to ensure consistent behavior across runs. The project aims to offer a stealth browser for web automation and AI agent functionalities.

items.title: RemoveMacAI
items.description: Turn off Apple Intelligence on macOS 27 and get its disk space back. One command, fully reversible.
items.summary: The sources indicate that RemoveMacAI is an open-source utility designed to disable Apple Intelligence on macOS 27, allowing users to reclaim disk space consumed by on-device machine learning models. The tool operates via terminal commands, providing a reversible method to manage both functionality and associated files. It does not directly modify system files under `/System`, instead using a configuration profile to apply Apple's restriction keys and redirect downloads. The utility can show the current state, turn off features, simulate changes, or revert all modifications. It disables a range of integrated capabilities including Hey Siri, menu bar shortcuts, and AI-driven summaries. The sources do not provide a definitive answer regarding the exact command to fully turn off Apple Intelligence and reclaim disk space.

items.title: vibe-wise
items.description: A Claude Code plugin that helps you learn how to build while AI writes the code.
items.summary: Vibe-wise is a Claude Code plugin that helps users learn how to build while AI writes the code. It puts learning first and keeps users in control, asking for their approach first, discussing tradeoffs, and explaining unfamiliar concepts before writing any code. The plugin is useful for walking through Build, Design, and Implementation checkpoints, learning unfamiliar stacks, and designing data schemas for apps. It emphasizes thinking before coding to ensure a deeper understanding of what is being built.

items.title: yomiyasu
items.description: AI生成の日本語を自然な日本語へ推敲するAgent Skill / Agent Skill for Refining AI-Generated Japanese into Natural Japanese
items.summary: The Agent Skill "yomiyasu" refines AI-generated Japanese into natural, readable Japanese by focusing on restoring the grammatical structure ("who did what") and making vague metaphors more specific. Unlike traditional methods that simply ban certain words, yomiyasu aims to improve the readability of AI-generated text by reconstructing sentence structures and clarifying ambiguous expressions. It is available on platforms like Claude Code and Codex, and its latest update, v1.0.1, enhances the retention of the original text's tone while removing AI-specific syntax. The skill is designed to reduce the burden of creating technical articles and business documents.

items.title: answer-me-with-html
items.description: Answer me with HTML — an agent skill that answers hard questions with a one-page HTML you can actually read. 让 AI Agent 用一页 HTML 回答复杂问题。
items.summary: Answer me with HTML is an open-source AI agent skill developed by QingYunA for AI coding assistants like Claude Code, Codex CLI, and ChatGPT. It answers complex questions with a one-page HTML document that is easy to read. The tool generates a short draft of about 900 output tokens instead of 7,000 tokens of HTML, CSS, and SVG, computes panel placement and diagram coordinates, and fixes its own mistakes. It has 285 GitHub stars and is available on GitHub.

items.title: easyread
items.description: 把英文论文读成舒服的中文：本地 PDF 论文翻译、原文对照、边读边问 AI、文献管理。Read English papers in comfortable Chinese.
items.summary: easyread is an open-source AI skill designed to help users read English papers in comfortable Chinese by translating local PDFs, providing original text comparisons, and allowing users to ask AI questions while reading. It supports features like formula and table formatting, note-taking, and literature management. The project has 601 GitHub stars and is built by Edwardxlai. It is part of AI coding assistants like Claude Code, Codex CLI, and ChatGPT.

items.title: mcp-extensions
items.description: Build plugins that feel like native, first-class features of ChatGPT.
items.summary: The sources indicate that "MCP Extensions" allow developers to build plugins that feel like native, first-class features of ChatGPT. These extensions enable developers to integrate their plugins into key surfaces of the user experience, including the sidebar, composer, and file viewers. They also mention the use of rich forms and deep links to enhance the interaction between the plugin and the chat interface. The sources also highlight the Model Context Protocol (MCP) as a method for establishing a consistent communication path between clients and servers, which is seen as a more integrated approach compared to traditional plugins.

items.title: oil-ui
items.description: 把 AI 的 UI 设计能力推到极限。
items.summary: The sources indicate that oil-ui aims to push the limits of AI's UI design capabilities by providing a structured, iterative design process that includes scanning code, listening to client needs, offering style family options, and providing visual choices and full previews. It emphasizes a neutral, non-prescriptive approach to design, allowing clients to define their product and brand preferences before presenting options. The process is supported by a visual preview template and is applicable to new projects for establishing design systems or existing projects for UI review and improvement.

items.title: open-dot
items.description: Open-source personal AI agents that work on their own, on their own computers. Mac app, OpenAI + Composio.
items.summary: Open Dot is an open-source, self-hosted alternative to the always-on personal AI agents called Dots launched by OpenAI. It is a Mac app that runs always-on personal AI agents on your own computer, each with its own logged-in browser, connecting to various apps via Composio. Open Dot is roughly a tenth of the cost of Dots and is available for evaluation as an early prototype. It is an open-source project hosted on GitHub and is an alternative to other AI agents like Meta Muse, Grok Bot, and ChatGPT agent.

items.title: whirl
items.description: The AI chat app that sweats the details. Every top model, real memory, living documents, and your own tools.
items.summary: Whirl is described as an AI chat app that emphasizes detail and security, featuring locked chats encrypted on the device, zero-retention models, and various functionalities like incognito mode, voice input, and file attachments. It supports integrations with personal tools and offers long-term memory for preferences and projects. Whirl also includes living documents and web search capabilities. The app is built with optional features powered by various services, which can be enabled or disabled based on specific needs.

items.title: EvoVLM
items.description: Evolving Multimodal Inference Programs: LLM-guided evolutionary search for accurate and efficient vision-language inference.
items.summary: EvoVLM is an evolutionary search framework for vision-language inference programs guided by LLMs, aiming for accurate and efficient multimodal inference. The framework leverages LLMs to script genetic algorithms and API call wrappers, though specialized research compute and evaluation are required for competitive architecture design. The sources indicate EvoVLM's potential in discovering advanced reasoning strategies through guided exploration, suggesting that the prompt space contains generalizable programs for complex cognitive tasks. The sources also mention that the framework's success across diverse tasks suggests its potential in evolving prompts that enhance model performance.

items.title: strands-decider
items.description: A small, fast decision model, or system one model, for agentic workflows. Pick between options or rate on a scale faster than an LLM, with a calibrated confidence on every decision.
items.summary: Strands Decider is a small, fast decision model, or "system one" model, designed to pick between sets of options or rate on a scale with calibrated confidence, faster than an LLM. It uses a pretrained decoder LLM torso, discarding its language-modelling head and replacing it with a small pointer head to score options. It operates in about 115 ms on an RTX 3090 and runs locally. While it is efficient and reliable for agentic workflows, it is not suited for complex problem-solving, coding, chatbots, or document summarization due to its lack of text generation capability.

items.summary: The provided sources indicate that Discord-Server-Raider is an AI-driven tool that optimizes server management and enhances user experience without any connection to Apple or iOS devices. The sources describe a Discord AI bot for community management that is GPT-4o-powered and handles tasks such as answering member questions, auto-moderating conversations, and behaving differently in each channel based on custom system prompts. The sources also mention AiGuild as a tool for simplifying the creation and management of Discord servers, with 464 servers listed in its directory. However, no specific details about Discord-Server-Raider's connection to Apple or iOS devices are provided in the sources.

items.title: leviathan
items.description: **Deep memory for agents over large datasets.**   Leviathan is a single static binary that turns your records (JSONL, JSON, CSV/TSV, SQLite, or anything a database CLI can export) into a ranked full-text index.
items.summary: Leviathan is a single static binary that converts various data formats into a ranked full-text index, enabling agents to handle temporal queries and multi-hop reasoning efficiently. It is part of a broader trend in 2026 where AI agent memory is treated as a dedicated architectural component separate from the model’s context window, allowing agents to retain information across sessions and improving their ability to remember user preferences and prior contexts. The sources highlight that Leviathan excels in transforming records into a full-text index, which is crucial for agents to maintain continuity and context-awareness in interactions.

items.title: agentcraft
items.summary: AgentCraft is an open-source tool that reimagines AI coding agents through an RTS-style command center, allowing users to manage AI agents in a real-time strategy experience. It installs lightweight hooks into agent CLIs to report session events to a server that renders everything in a browser-based game UI. On GitHub, AgentCraft is described as a Spigot plugin for Minecraft that spawns intelligent NPC agents backed by Claude, capable of autonomous navigation and various tasks. In a video by Iddo Salomon, AgentCraft is presented as a tool for agent orchestration inspired by real-time strategy games, featuring a Warcraft 3 themed interface to manage multiple AI agents effectively.

items.title: SCM
items.description: Deep AI search for every photo and every frame of video in any folder on macOS
items.summary: SCM, an MIT-licensed Electron app for macOS, indexes every photo and every video frame in watched folders on-device, enabling offline CLIP search without cloud calls. It offers five search modes: Files, Scenes, OCR via Tesseract in 35+ languages, Dialogue via Whisper transcription, and an optional local LLMs 'Ask' chat. The default model is CLIP ViT-L/14@336 at roughly 435MB, with 480-570ms per image on CPU and SigLIP variants offered as speed/detail trade-offs. SCM targets folders, external-drive archives, and other collections outside Apple Photos, providing local retrieval systems across user-selected folders.

items.title: Papermorph
items.description: An AI skill that turns books into animated, narrated, interactive web experiences
items.summary: Papermorph is an AI skill that converts books into animated, narrated, interactive web experiences. It transforms PDFs into animated web books with animated lessons and interactive quizzes. The current version uses Opus 5.5 and lacks image models, multilingual support, or background music. Future plans include expanding to include image models and storyboarding for interactive picture books and humanities documentaries. The skill is available on GitHub under an MIT license with 83 stars and 5 forks.

items.title: bootloops
items.description: BootLoops 1.0: certified computational tools and house engines for exact and high-precision physics and quantitative science, built to be driven by LLM agents. MIT; docs CC BY 4.0.
items.summary: BootLoops 1.0 is an open-source toolkit released on October 1, 2026, by Harvard physicist Matthew D. Schwartz. It is designed to bridge the gap between large language models and scientific research, allowing researchers to automate complex calculations by generating precise Python scripts. The toolkit is MIT licensed, enabling users to use, modify, and build upon it. BootLoops has produced 36 manuscripts in 3 months and spans various fields including ecology, genetics, economics, linguistics, and physics. The toolkit is model-agnostic and built with Claude Code, facilitating exact quantitative calculations.

items.title: agentmemoryrepo
items.description: Spec for Agent Memory Repo
items.summary: The agentmemoryrepo spec for Agent Memory Repo includes a retrieval rate of 95.2% on LongMemEval-S, 68.5% on LoCoMo, 83.2% on LoCoMo, and 63.8% on LongMemEval. It uses 0Qdrant, pgvector, Postgres, and Neo4j for external dependencies and offers 130 REST endpoints and 54 MCP tools. It is built on the iii engine, with 12 auto-capture hooks for every coding agent, and it is not a library or vector store but a complete memory runtime. The GitHub repository specifies a 200-line cap for scale, BM25 + vector + graph search, and ~1,900 tokens for token cost. The project is maintained by RAVBYTE TECHNOLOGIES PRIVATE LIMITED and is open for community contributions.

items.title: hermes-gadget-sdk
items.description: Build voice and text devices for your Hermes Agent, with ESP32 firmware, a Linux client, and a desktop simulator.
items.summary: Hermes Agent is an open-source AI agent released by Nous Research in February 2026, which supports Linux, macOS, and WSL2. It can be installed via a single curl command and offers capabilities like web search, browser automation, vision analysis, and text-to-speech. The Hermes-gadget-sdk is used to build voice and text devices for the Hermes Agent, utilizing ESP32 firmware, a Linux client, and a desktop simulator. The SDK is part of a project to build a local voice satellite for Hermes or OpenClaw, which involves connections between a speaker, ESP32, and status-led components. The project is hosted on Schematik and is part of the Build Season 2026.

items.title: dioramas
items.description: A free, open-source framework for cinematic, interactive 3D websites with AI-generated assets (Nano Banana 2 + Meshy 7.1 on fal). 20 example sites.
items.summary: Dioramas is a free, open-source framework for creating cinematic, interactive 3D websites with AI-generated assets. It uses Nano Banana 2 and Meshy 7.1 on fal to generate assets. The framework ships with 20 complete example sites, including projects like Atlas of Drifting Isles and Aurel Horologie. It was launched on Sept. 30, 2026, and has 206 upvotes on Nicheloom. The framework combines Three.js/React Three Fiber with 3D generation APIs to render interactive 3D dioramas.

items.title: Autoloom
items.description: AI coding with Aegis governance built into execution: baseline-aware changes, evidence-backed delivery. Free desktop client, your choice of model. 将哲科思维融入 AI 开发执行，让变更有依据、交付有证据。用创意编织现实。
items.summary: Aegis is an open-source AI agents skill for AI coding assistants, developed by GanyuanRan, that aims to make AI coding agents architecture-aware, baseline-first, evidence-verified, drift-checked, and safe across long tasks. It has been shown to improve contract pass rates from 61.67% to 93.33% and reduce unsafe outcomes from 13.33% to 0% in a held-out A/B benchmark. Aegis integrates governance into the AI coding process, ensuring traceability of AI-supported changes and embedding technical control mechanisms within the development environment for better auditability and safety.

items.title: academic-deai
items.description: Model-agnostic Chinese and English academic editing for the latest models across Agent platforms. Reduce formulaic prose while preserving evidence and author voice.
items.summary: For model-agnostic Chinese and English academic editing, the sources recommend using different AI models for different purposes. For most academic manuscripts, the default recommendation is Claude Sonnet 5, which balances editing quality, faithfulness, and reasoning while preserving the author's intended meaning. For deep rewrites, difficult arguments, or structural feedback, choose Claude Opus 5. For fluent, natural-sounding English, GPT-5.6 is especially useful for reviews, perspectives, proposals, and narrative-heavy academic writing. For very long manuscripts or extensive supporting context, Gemini 3.8 Flash is attractive for its long-context capability. However, the sources also note that there isn't a single best AI model for all academic writing tasks, as different models excel in different areas.

items.title: Comma
items.description: Best free & open source personal agent. Always-on, proactive, sessionless. Browser, computer use, files, remote control. Competiable with ChatGPT/codex and claude code. Selfhost your open source alternative to Muse, Dots, Instinct and Town. Built with Go/Elixir/Lean.
items.summary: Comma is an open-source sessionless personal agent built to be sessionless. It breaks down your goals into Tasks and keeps working through agentic loops until the job is done. It is an alternative to Muse, Dots, Instinct, and Town. Comma is built for long-running, fault-tolerant agent workloads, primarily using Elixir/OTP, with Lean used for critical systems components. It can read and change files on connected devices, run commands, and hand work to Codex, Claude Code, Pi, or Kimi. The Mac app can record calls, save them to Drive, and start a summary Task. The sources don't provide a definitive answer to specific details like official website or phone number.

The workspace inside Pi is mounted from the host directory, allowing changes to be reflected back to the host.

items.summary: Open Instinct is an open-source personal assistant that functions as an iMessage agent, with its own computer and a network of other agents. It can handle tasks like booking movie tickets and managing passwords, and it is self-hostable. The primary interface is a text conversation, including iMessage and WhatsApp, plus phone calls. It operates on a persistent cloud computer and reaches connected services with stored credentials. It is open source under MIT, free to self-host, and has a large community and hosting ecosystem. However, users manage setup, security, and updates themselves, and there is no native desktop or iOS app.

items.title: pi-pocket
items.description: A durable, multiplayer, mobile-first web app for Pi agents, built on Pi Durable
items.summary: Pi Durable is an experimental framework from Arendelle, released alongside Pi 1.0, for building applications around agent conversations that need to survive restarts. It treats conversations as durable state, checkpointing them, allowing resumption after a crash, and enabling multiple conversations to run simultaneously, each with its own model, tools, instructions, and working directory. It is a separate package from the main Pi framework, designed for applications requiring agent conversations to persist across process restarts, support multiple simultaneous conversations, or allow multiple clients to observe and steer the same session.

items.title: TIRx-harness
items.description: An Open Compiler Harness for Agentic GPU Programming
items.summary: TIRx Harness is an open compiler harness for agentic GPU programming, combining a minimal stable compiler foundation, a knowledge base, tools, and a benchmark server to help agents develop correct, fast GPU kernels. It is available on GitHub at https://github.com/mlc-ai/tirx-harness and can be installed using the command `python -m pip install tirx-harness`. The project aims to provide a reliable environment for kernel optimization, as evidenced by its performance on evaluated workloads, achieving geometric-mean speedups of 2.94× over FlashKDA (forward) and 6.84× over Flash Linear Attention (FLA) (backward).
